fields.condition: its retained bytes encode a key at least one of whose identity components was serialized with an enum metadata code (Int32Enum, ByteEnum, Int16Enum, or Int64Enum)
fields.postcondition: a GhostShardKey never silently deserializes an enum-typed key component as a plain integer; callers holding a serialized enum-component key must deserialize it with the concrete ShardKey<...> type
fields.response: throw InvalidShardKeyMetadataException because the binary metadata header records only the enum component's underlying integer width rather than the concrete CLR enum type, so untyped GhostShardKey deserialization maps the component code to its underlying integer primitive and the constructed ShardKey<...> rejects the enum metadata code as a type mismatch
